invalidInput: Check the search request and try again.
unavailable: Search is temporarily unavailable. Your content is still available.
conflict: The search settings changed. Reload them and try again.
notFound: This search resource is no longer available.
limit: The search limit was reached. Try a smaller scope or wait for the current request.
configuration: Search is not configured for this operation.
indexChanged: The search index changed. Run the search again.
forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this search operation.
settingsHint: Manage search sources, indexes, language packs and diagnostics.
managed: Search is managed by your administrator. Use Content in the search dialog to search saved content.
oneSourceHint: You can test multiple sources. Only the live source serves user searches.
name: Name
profileHint: Add search, vector storage and embedding connections. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again. To rotate credentials, add a new connection and update the source or retrieval profile.
indexSavedContent: Index saved content in this scope
pathRulesHint: Use one source file or directory path per line. Leave Include empty to include all saved content. Exclusions take priority. Preview the scope to check paths.
testHint: Tests use the source selected above and do not change the live source.
languageHint: English analysis is built in. Import versioned recipes for other languages, then select an analyzer for each index. Changing the analyzer rebuilds that index.
recipeHint: Review the exact source and versions before installing. Recipe packages contain data, not executable scripts.
connectionReady: Connection metadata is available. No embeddings were generated.
searchHint: Choose a scope and enter a query. The first search prepares an index for that scope.
indexFailed: Indexing failed. Check search settings and retry.
indexDisabled: Indexing is disabled for this scope.
title: Search
notReady: Build and test an index for this source before using it for user searches.
auditHint: Checks run automatically in the background. Confirmed index damage is repaired without changing your content or approving knowledge.
auditDisabled: Enable indexing to check this scope.
auditEmpty: No completed check for this index yet.
auditHealthy: The current index passed its integrity check.
auditPartial: Only part of this index could be verified.
auditCorrupt: The index does not match its saved content.
auditUnverified: This index needs a new integrity record.
auditOutdated: The index is out of date.
auditUnavailable: The check could not complete. It will retry automatically.
auditForbidden: Check the search connection and content permissions.
auditSuperseded: The index changed during the check. A new check will follow.
auditEarlier: This result belongs to an earlier index. A fresh check is pending.
semanticHint: Semantic and hybrid search use approved knowledge and may call your configured embedding service. Queries run only when you press Search.
submitQuery: Enter a query and press Search.
readyToSearch: Index ready. Press Search to run your query.
endpointHint: Use the service URL reachable from the Panda server. HTTP and HTTPS are supported; optional CA certificates are stored with the connection.
embeddingEndpointHint: Enter the embedding API base URL, exact model and dimensions. For an OpenAI-compatible API, include its base path (for example, /v1). Saving a connection does not call the model.
sourceKnowledgeHint: Optional: pair a vector store with an embedding model. Adding a profile does not enable vector indexing or generate knowledge.
knowledgeProfilesHint: Pair a Milvus connection with an embedding connection, then attach the profile to a search source. Existing profiles are immutable; create a new one to change the pairing.
vectorOptInHint: Vector indexing is optional and requires a retrieval profile on this source. Saving or rebuilding an enabled vector index may call the embedding service.
knowledgeRangeHint: Choose original documents whose approved knowledge can be indexed. Every source of a knowledge record must match. Exclusions apply to descendants and take priority. These rules never generate or approve knowledge.
knowledgeSelectionSummary: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} · {subtrees, plural, one {# subtree} other {# subtrees}} · {exclusions, plural, one {# exclusion} other {# exclusions}}
embeddingUsage: Today: {calls, number} / {callLimit, number} embedding calls · {characters, number} / {characterLimit, number} characters. Resets {reset}.
embeddingUsageHint: Counts include failed requests. Actual billing is determined by your model provider.
projectShared: Project search settings are shared by all members. Each search uses your current permissions.
policyNeedsReview: Previous project settings need review. Choose and save shared settings before search can resume.
projectReviewPending: Project search is waiting for your administrator to confirm its settings.
previousSettingsHint: Review the preserved settings, then load a version into the form. Nothing changes until you save.
previousPolicyPaths: {included, plural, one {# include path} other {# include paths}} · {excluded, plural, one {# exclude path} other {# exclude paths}}
policyDraftLoaded: Previous settings loaded for review. Check the form and save to apply them.
previousUnavailable: These settings cannot be loaded. Choose another version or configure the index manually.
buildHint: You can leave this page. Progress is saved, and rebuilding does not regenerate or approve knowledge. Counts apply to the current step.
contentKindsHint: Select at least one type. These choices affect full-text search; knowledge rules remain separate.
storageHint: Check vector indexes and safely clean up unused resources without calling a model. Checks use the selected connection; connections to the same storage share progress.
storageAutomatic: Used storage is checked automatically. You can leave this page and return later.
storageManual: This connection is not in use. Checks run when you request them.
storageAccessDenied: Storage access was denied. Check the connection credentials, then retry.
storageRetryHint: The request could not be confirmed. Retry to continue the same check; your previous result is kept.
storageReadFailed: The current status is temporarily unavailable. Your previous result is kept.
storageRetainedHint: Resources without verified ownership or references are kept. Missing or unavailable resources may need a source index check.
